fields.description: Issue includes editorial commentary criticizing Miami Mayor E. ("Ev") Sewell and discussing a reported proposal to require publishers to post bond as a guarantee of financial responsibility in libel actions, referencing a $250,000 slander suit by the Daily Tribune. Coverage also focuses on gambling and the tourist season in Greater Miami, including discussion of pari-mutuel wagering and enforcement, and extensive horse-racing tips and advertisements tied to Hialeah Park and Tropical Park ("Jockey Jimmy" selections and reports). Additional content includes a column on religious persecution of Catholics in Mexico, local news briefs, society/nightlife items and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach venues, and a home modernization feature promoting Federal Housing Act loans for plumbing and bathroom improvements.
